name: labs/ni__nidaqmx-python
title: NI-DAQmx analog input task (voltage measurement)
intro: NI-DAQmx analog input task (voltage measurement), adapted from ni/nidaqmx-python. It reads `task_done`, `channel_name` and `measure_voltage`; runs `sample_voltages`, `start_task` and `stop_task`. `sample_voltages`: acquire a block of voltage samples from the analog input task. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/ni__nidaqmx-python --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/ni__nidaqmx-python --backend fake --mcp
